channel.title: Canadian Citizenship Test Blog
channel.description: Guides to the Canadian citizenship test: format, pass mark, study plans for Discover Canada, retakes and test day, each checked against canada.ca.

item.title: What happens if you fail the Canadian citizenship test?
item.description: Failing once doesn't end your application. You get 3 chances in 30 days, then a hearing. What the hearing involves and how to pass next time.

item.title: How to study Discover Canada: a 4-week plan for the citizenship test
item.description: Every citizenship test question comes from Discover Canada. A 4-week plan, chapter by chapter, plus the facts that have changed since 2012.

item.title: Canadian citizenship test format: questions, pass mark and time limit
item.description: The Canadian citizenship test has 20 questions, a 45-minute limit and a pass mark of 15. Who takes it, what's on it, and how the online test works.
